$comment: Generated from packages/ui/tokens by `npm run tokens:build`. Do not edit: change the tokens and rebuild. Maps every custom property that 1.0 no longer defines to what replaces it, from packages/ui/tokens/removed-tokens.json: the token (token, with its custom property, cssVariable) or the hand-written property (cssVariable alone) that takes its place, a fixed color's value, or nothing for a removed one. kind says why: prefixed (only the --env- prefix is new), renamed, alias (a 0.7 alias, removed for its role), fixed (a 0.7 color no role replaces) or removed; a note says what changed beyond the name. npm run tokens:build copies it into the tokens section of the codemods' rename map and the token list of docs/migration.md.

--icon-button-size.note: An icon button is as tall as the other controls of its size.

--line-height-body.note: The body line height an application may set; envUI reads it with a fallback of 1.4.

--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-large.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--md-sys-shape-corner-extra-small.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--md-sys-shape-corner-full.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--md-sys-shape-corner-large.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--md-sys-shape-corner-medium.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--md-sys-shape-corner-none.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--md-sys-shape-corner-small.note: The old corner scale is the radius scale now.

--motion-ease-standard.note: The standard easing is --env-motion-ease; the alias, the same curve, is gone.

--radius-large.note: One radius scale: the large corner is its lg step.

--radius-standard.note: One radius scale: the standard corner is its sm step.

--scale.note: The multiplier is gone: components read sized tokens. Set scale="compact" on a Theme for the compact scale.

--state-dialog-overlay-opacity.note: The backdrop is a translucent color token now.

--state-fill-hover-opacity.note: The fill's states are color tokens now.

--state-fill-opacity.note: The neutral fill is a translucent color token; layer it over a surface rather than mixing.

--state-fill-pressed-opacity.note: The fill's states are color tokens now.

--state-hover-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the role's -hover token.

--state-hover-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-layer-hover-opacity.note: The state layer is a color token now.

--state-layer-pressed-opacity.note: The state layer is a color token now.

--state-lightness-direction.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: every role has hover and pressed tokens.

--state-lightness-threshold.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-pressed-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the role's -pressed token.

--state-pressed-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-surface-hover-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the surface's -hover token.

--state-surface-hover-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-surface-pressed-lightness.note: The runtime hover rule is gone: use the surface's -pressed token.

--state-surface-pressed-shift.note: The runtime hover rule is gone.

--state-tone-subtle-opacity.note: Each tone has its tint as a color token: color.bg.{tone}.muted.

--surface-card-padding.note: Internal to the 0.7 card. Set a card's padding with its padding prop.

--toast-fill.note: Internal to the 0.7 toast. A toast takes its fill from its tone; restyle a toast through the component, not this property.
